# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** In her early twenties  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, plain, wholesome, and sensible, with a plump figure. During her wedding, she wore an extravagant attire of white satin, lace, and diamonds.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v3 c1 P15](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0015), [v3 c36 P10](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is a practical, sensible, and matter-of-fact person who lacks a vivid imagination. She is conscientious, even-tempered, and well-behaved, rarely making unkind remarks or causing trouble. In her professional life, she believes in strict discipline and the necessity of corporal punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c4 P5](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0005), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014), [v2 c4 P19](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0019)_

## Traits

- Practical  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Sensible  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v3 c1 P15](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0015)</sub>

- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v2 c4 P5](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0005), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c1 P10](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0010)</sub>
- Domestic science and needlework  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v2 c6 P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn her salary, satisfy school trustees, and achieve a good reputation as a teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P5](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0005)</sub>

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school with Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. She later studied at Queen's Academy alongside Anne and passed her examinations to become a teacher. After graduation, she taught at Newbridge School, where she gained a reputation for being a firm disciplinarian who believed in using corporal punishment. She later took a teaching position in the Canadian West. Prior to her departure for the West, Jane acted as an intermediary for her brother Billy by proposing marriage to Anne on his behalf. Eventually, Jane met and married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Winnipeg millionaire, in a lavish wedding, after which they went on a European tour.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014), [v3 c1 P10](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0010), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as the daughter of Harmon Andrews and sister to Billy and Alice  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Quotes

> If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them.  <sub>[v2 c4 P3](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0003)</sub>

> Indeed, I could and would, if they deserved it. Give them a good whipping, of course.  <sub>[v2 c4 P5](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0005)</sub>

> I’ll whip my pupils when they’re naughty. It’s the shortest and easiest way of convincing them.  <sub>[v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)</sub>

> Would you like him for a husband? Billy wants to marry you.  <sub>[v3 c8 P10](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0010)</sub>

> Billy is a good fellow. I must say that, if he is my brother. He has no bad habits and he’s a great worker, and you can depend on him.  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
